Academic and Students Services
Library cum Auditorium
The library cum Auditorium is central facility to support the students and the teaching activities of the college.
					The library of the college is a spacious building to cater to the educational needs of the student community and
					the teachers alike for humanities and social sciences subjects.
The library is going to equip with a large collection of books with journals, periodicals and newspapers of
        national and global importance. The library cum auditorium is a new and big building to provide students reading
        facilities and to hold different meetings, conferences, workshops etc., and is operative from the next academic session.
Hostel Accommodation for Women Students
The college has a women's hostel under active construction to accommodate about 100 boarders from distant places.
        The hostel is spacious and is planned to have another storey to accommodate more students.
The women's hostel of the college is unique in rural areas like Jiadhal. Students who wish to avail hostel facilities
        should fill in the hostel application form available at the college office.

GYM
The college has a well-maintained multi-gym for maintaining the fitness and health of students and teachers.
Ragging
The college strictly follows Government rules against ragging. Students may face severe punishment for:
Encouraging or participating in ragging of any type
Destruction of college property
Misbehavior towards girls, women, teachers, employees, or any person in the college
Financial Assistance
Scholarships are available for students belonging to SC/ST/OBC/MOBC categories as per Government rules.
        Students may contact the Principal or the Scholarship Branch of Jiadhal College for more information.
